records.source: the Annotate screen's own filter on the key, read the way the grid reads it (AND, OR, NOT, case-insensitive terms). Every count below it, ``n_rows`` included, is over the crops that matched — a denominator taken from the whole table would put the numerator and the denominator on two different populations. ``n_rows_unfiltered`` keeps the total, and a note says how many were excluded.
records.context: the Annotate application view's own filter on the structured-data name, read the way the grid reads it (AND, OR, NOT, case-insensitive terms). Every count below it, ``n_rows`` included, is over the extracted image regions that matched — a denominator taken from the whole table would put the numerator and the denominator on two different populations. ``n_rows_unfiltered`` keeps the total, and a note says how many were excluded.
records.translation: Annotate 视图自身对键的过滤器，按网格的读法解读（AND、OR、NOT，词项不区分大小写）。其下的每个计数（包括 ``n_rows``）都只针对匹配的提取图像区域——如果分母取自整张表，分子和分母就会落在两个不同的总体上。 ``n_rows_unfiltered`` 保留总数，并有一条说明指出排除了多少条。

records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#5
records.source: object tables to take features from; missing ones are skipped, and ``None`` means the tables of the object types the crops show. A crop's own table (``nucleus`` for a nucleus crop) gives the object's own row, a parent table (``cell`` or ``cytoplasm``) the row of the cell it lies in, and any other table the mean of the rows inside that cell. A crop is kept when its own table is selected and holds its row, or, when its own table is not selected, when any selected table describes it.
records.context: object tables to take features from; missing ones are skipped, and ``None`` means the tables of the object types the extracted image regions show. An extracted image region's own table (``nucleus`` for a nucleus extracted image region) gives the object's own row, a parent table (``cell`` or ``cytoplasm``) the row of the cell it lies in, and any other table the mean of the rows inside that cell. An extracted image region is kept when its own table is selected and holds its row, or, when its own table is not selected, when any selected table describes it.
records.translation: 提取特征所用的对象表；缺失的表会被跳过， ``None`` 表示提取图像区域所显示对象类型的表。区域自身的表（细胞核区域为 ``nucleus``）给出对象自己的行，上级表（ ``cell`` 或 ``cytoplasm``）给出对象所在细胞的行，其他任何表给出该细胞内各行的均值。当区域自身的表被选中且含有其行时保留该区域；若自身的表未被选中，则在任一选中的表描述了该区域时保留它。

records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#6
records.source: a cell holding more nuclei than this gets no mean nucleus features; ``None`` sets no limit.
records.context: a cell holding more nuclei than this gets no mean nucleus features; ``None`` sets no limit.
records.translation: 所含细胞核多于此值的细胞不会得到细胞核均值特征； ``None`` 表示不设上限。

records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#7
records.source: a cell holding more pathogens than this gets no mean pathogen features; ``None`` sets no limit.

records.translation: 所含病原体多于此值的细胞不会得到病原体均值特征； ``None`` 表示不设上限。

records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#8
records.source: keep only the features of these channel groups, ``channel_<n>`` and ``none`` for features no single channel enters (area, shape); ``None`` keeps every channel.
records.context: keep only the features of these channel groups, ``channel_<n>`` and ``none`` for features no single channel enters (area, shape); ``None`` keeps every channel.
records.translation: 只保留这些通道组的特征：``channel_<n>``，以及用于不涉及单一通道的特征（面积、形状）的 ``none``； ``None`` 保留所有通道。

records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#9
records.source: keep only these feature families, as named in :data:`spacr.feature_dict.FEATURE_FAMILIES` (``intensity``, ``morphology``, ``texture`` and so on); ``None`` keeps every family.
records.context: keep only these feature families, as named in :data:`spacr.feature_dict.FEATURE_FAMILIES` (``intensity``, ``morphology``, ``texture`` and so on); ``None`` keeps every family.
records.translation: 只保留这些特征类别，名称见 :data:`spacr.feature_dict.FEATURE_FAMILIES`（ ``intensity``、 ``morphology``、 ``texture`` 等）； ``None`` 保留所有类别。

records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#11
records.source: when none of the object tables can be read, when the channel and family selection leaves no feature column, or when crops and measured objects exist and not one crop matches an object; the last names a crop key and an object key.
records.context: when none of the object tables can be read, when the channel and family selection leaves no feature column, or when extracted image regions and measured objects exist and not one extracted image region matches an object; the last names an extracted image region structured-data name and an object identifier.
records.translation: 当所有对象表都无法读取、当通道和类别选择没有留下任何特征列，或者存在提取图像区域和已测量对象却没有任何区域与对象匹配时引发；最后一种情况会给出一个区域键和一个对象键。
